==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|publicen}} (by analogy with {{m|en|banish}}, {{m|en|finish}}), from {{der|en|fro|publier}}, from {{der|en|la|publicare||to make public, show or tell to the people, make known, declare, also (and earlier) confiscate for public use}}, from {{m|la|publicus||pertaining to the people, public}}; see {{m|en|public}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|pŭb'lĭsh}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈpʌblɪʃ/}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-publish.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpʊblɪʃ/|a=Northern England,Ireland}}
* {{rhymes|en|ʌblɪʃ|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|pub|lish}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To issue (something, such as [[print]]ed work) for [[distribution]] and/or [[sale]].
#: {{ux|en|The ''Times'' '''published''' the investigative piece about the governor both in print and online.}}
#: {{ux|en|Most of the sketches Faulkner '''published''' in 1925 appeared in the Sunday magazine section of the ''New Orleans Times-Picayune''.}}
#: {{ux|en|The State combined public information strategies and '''published''' billboards, pamphlets, and newsletter articles under the campaign theme, Give 'Em the Boot.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[announce]] to the [[public]].
#: {{ux|en|The Secretary of Health and Human Services '''published''' a press release on May 22, 2013.}}
#: {{ux|en|The Bolshevik government '''published''' an announcement of the tsar's death.}}
#: {{ux|en|No newspaper '''published''' the victim's name.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To issue the work of (an author).
#: {{ux|en|Grove Press '''published''' many avant-garde authors.}}
# {{lb|en|Internet|transitive}} To disseminate (a message) publicly via a [[newsgroup]], [[forum]], [[blog]], etc.
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[issue]] a [[medium]] (e.g. [[publication]]).
#: {{ux|en|Major city papers still '''publish''' daily.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To have one's work accepted for a publication.
#: {{ux|en|She needs to '''publish''' in order to get tenure.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|of content}} To be made available in a printed publication or other medium. <!--ergative?-->
#: {{ux|en|The article first '''published''' online, then in print the next day.}}
# {{lb|en|programming}} To make (information such as an [[event]]) available to [[component]]s that wish to be notified ([[subscriber]]s).
# {{lb|en|Christianity}} To [[preach]] (as a [[Jehovah's Witness]]).

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|es|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|to announce to the public}} {{l|en|disclose}}, {{l|en|make known}}; See also [[Thesaurus:announce]]
* {{sense|to disseminate publicly via a newsgroup, forum, blog, etc.}} {{l|en|post}}

====Antonyms====
* (To make (information such as an event) available to components that wish to be notified) [[private]]
